listing.summary: A long awaited (by like, maybe 2 people) sequel to Payout Tweaker. CHANGE mission REWARDS! change BOUNTY REWARDS! Lunalib integration for changeable settings WITHOUT restart! THREE TIMES the settings!
listing.aiSummary: Allows players to change mission and bounty rewards with adjustable multipliers.

description: Provides a sequel to Payout Tweaker that lets users modify mission and bounty payouts. It features three times as many settings as its predecessor and integrates with Lunalib for live configuration changes without restarting the game.
